candidates.headline: Source: Giants WR Calvin Austin (torn ACL) out for season
candidates.description: Giants wide receiver Calvin Austin III will miss the upcoming season after suffering a torn ACL in his right knee while running a route at Tuesday's training camp practice, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

candidates.headline: Sources: Giants trading OL Josh Ezeudu to Chiefs for '28 pick
candidates.description: The Giants are trading offensive lineman Josh Ezeudu to the Chiefs for a 2028 seventh-round pick, sources said.

candidates.headline: Gonzalez focused on season, but irked by talks with Patriots
candidates.description: Cornerback Christian Gonzalez, 24, and the New England Patriots continue to discuss a contract extension, and with the regular-season opener Sept. 9 closing in, the veteran defensive back expressed disappointment the sides have yet to reach an agreement.

candidates.headline: Panthers coach Canales backs QB Young, defers on extension
candidates.description: Dave Canales reiterated Carolina's commitment to Bryce Young for the 2026 season but said any talk of a potential long-term pact with the quarterback will be the responsibility of the front office.

candidates.headline: Commanders to sign veteran tackle Humphries, source says
candidates.description: The Commanders, who lost Laremy Tunsil to a torn triceps on Aug. 5, are signing veteran tackle D.J. Humphries, a source told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Seahawks put Clark, Richman on season-ending injured reserve
candidates.description: Seahawks rookie safety Bud Clark and offensive lineman Mason Richman, who were both injured in the team's preseason game against the Titans on Sunday, will miss the 2026 season after being placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

candidates.headline: New York Giants WR Calvin Austin carted off practice field
candidates.description: New York receiver Calvin Austin III, 27, who signed with the Giants after spending four seasons with Pittsburgh, suffered a "serious" injury to his right knee while running a route at Tuesday's training camp practice, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

candidates.headline: Sources: Cardinals, Hjalte Froholdt reach 2-year, $20M extension
candidates.description: The Cardinals and center Hjalte Froholdt have agreed to terms on a two-year, $20 million contract extension, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport on Tuesday.

candidates.headline: Commanders release S Will Harris, place LB Drake Jackson on IR
candidates.description: The Commanders released veteran safety Will Harris on Tuesday, one year after he had opened the season as a starter.
